approved: Social Services Legislation Amendment (Workforce Incentive) Bill 2022

The Social Services Legislation Amendment (Workforce Incentive) Bill 2022 was introduced to allow age pension, disability support pension, and veteran entitlement recipients to have their pension suspended for up to two years—rather than cancelled after 12 weeks—when they exceed the income limit, and to retain their Pensioner Concession Card for two years, with an abridged reapplication process, to encourage workforce participation and address labour shortages.
